summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes plus a non-node input test and a Literal test. The 42 tests in the new module and test/test_path.py pass under the shared venv. ruff and black are not installed in that venv, so lint and formatting were checked only by line length and by hand. Nothing was committed.
